notes.title: 4k high quality version
notes.notes:
Some of you were asking for a version with a higher quality images - so here we go. 
4k images, compressed only a little bit. From 3.7 GB to 11.6 GB.

If you want to switch for a this build version, please follow this procedure:

- select LIVING WITH TEMPTATION 1 - REDUX (LUSCIOUS SECRETS) in the library
- press MANAGE and the PROPERTIES
- click BETAS and select BETA PARTICIPATION - HIGHQUALITY

notes.title: Work in progress - expected release date
notes.notes:
We're constantly progressing with the project and with every day we're closer to the release date.
The amount of scenes we have is just enormous and building the right connections and chronology between them is a very complicated and responsible task. In terms of texts, I’m only missing part of the WEEKEND ACTIONS WITH LISA – we got the rest and already everything is put together into the game file. In the following weeks I’ll be building connections between scenes and start to test everything.

In terms of the scale – the expansion (WGW + weekend actions) got new 4100 images in total (both static + animations) while the base version of the game has only 3100 images. Adding that amount of new content requires a lot of time to make sure that you’re putting everything together in the right order – with special care. 

I plan to release the game this APRIL / MAY.
